submission.implementation_notes: Iterative accumulator factorial compiled with Pebble 0.5.0 default settings (source: examples/uplc-cape/src/factorial.pebble). The compiler lowers the for-loop to a single tail-recursive UPLC function using UPLC 1.2 case/constr (builtin casing), so the artifact requires protocol version 11 (van Rossem), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18.
